text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Training journey, complete! Following 
Trainer's suggestion, I've decided to run 
in sprint and mile races!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“However, Trainer was worried that doing 
so would make it harder to compete against 
Yaeno and the others, who are aiming for 
medium and long distances...”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Sure, I want to run with everyone. But 
to have the absolute best showdown, I have 
to become the absolute best Umamusume 
first!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To make my "dream" come true, I'll become 
the greatest Umamusume in sprints and 
miles! My next target is the graded sprint 
race, the Swan Stakes!
